# Doro animation pack

Source: https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-pet/tree/e56528ff321fed127ed2e123efc34b9c9a1b4b26/assets/doro

Imported without image changes using `scripts/import_doro.py`. Local manifest records the pinned revision, numeric frame ordering and SHA-256 of every imported file. Browser playback and Navora task mappings are implemented by Navora.

Artwork contributed by stushansusu (manifest author: 11726). The upstream code/contribution MIT license does not grant rights to the underlying character. Doro is unofficial fan art derived from Dorothy in Goddess of Victory: NIKKE, owned by SHIFT UP and respective rights holders. Personal noncommercial use only. Preserve upstream LICENSE and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md when redistributing; no official affiliation is implied.
